description: This file contains functions for importing observations into the BORIS software from project files and spreadsheets, including handling of file dialogs, data validation, and user prompts.

methods.name: load_observations_from_boris_project
methods.description: Imports observations from a BORIS project file, handling user prompts for conflicts and missing behaviors or subjects.

methods.name: load_observations_from_spreadsheet
methods.description: Imports observations from an Excel or ODS spreadsheet, validating headers and appending events.

methods.name: import_observations
methods.description: Main function to open file dialog and delegate to specific import functions based on file type.
